findings.summary: crates/server/src/github.rs:84: AC-6 says a PR's checks finishing shows within 2 minutes, but no test covers that part; without a token reads are spaced 20+ minutes apart and only docs/STATUS.md mentions it.
findings.reason: tests/sources.rs with_a_token_finished_checks_show_on_the_next_minutes_read: with a token GitHub's interval is the 60 s INTERVAL, and a check going from in_progress to success shows as pending then pass across two refreshes. Without a token the 2-minute bound can't hold under GitHub's 60 requests an hour; STATUS.md says so, and the deployed server (TRU-12) gets a token.
